label: Computer Use 是什么

label: 为什么需要 Computer Use
action: 比较完成退货的两种入口
actionEn: Compare two routes to completing a return
look: 同一目标，两种入口
Two routes to the same goal
say: 目标是给 1048 号订单创建退货记录。上面这条路用 API，也就是给程序调用的接口，直接请求应用完成。下面这条路适用于没有合适 API 的地方：通过界面填表、提交。Computer Use 提供了这种入口，两条路也可以在同一个任务里配合。

The goal is to create a return for order 1048. The upper route uses an API, an interface programs can call directly. The lower route handles work without a suitable API by filling and submitting the form through the interface. Computer Use supplies that route, and a task can combine both.

label: Computer Use 如何工作
action: 连续播放截图、定位、填表和验证
actionEn: Play observation, targeting, form entry and verification
look: 新截图确认退货已创建
A fresh screenshot confirms the return
say: 右边是 context，也就是模型当前能用的信息：目标、截图和操作记录。左边已经标出了订单号输入框。把“要找什么”对应到屏幕位置，叫 UI grounding。 表单已经填好。模型通过 tool call 请求工具输入订单号、选择原因；工具执行后，新截图回到 context。现在确认的是表单填对了，还没有创建退货。 提交后，应用生成了 R-204 回执，新截图也把它带了回来。这才确认目标完成。Agent 就是这样把观察、判断、操作和结果检查接成循环。

The context on the right contains the goal, screenshot and action history available to the model. The order-number field is now marked on the left. Connecting what we want to a position on screen is called UI grounding. The form is now filled. Through tool calls, the model asks tools to enter the order number and choose a reason. A fresh screenshot returns to context. This confirms the fields, but the return has not been created yet. After submission, the app produced receipt R-204, and a fresh screenshot brought it back. Now the goal is confirmed. The agent connects observation, decisions, actions and checks into a loop.

label: 用新观察修正下一步

The fresh screenshot has brought the popup into context, and its Close button is located. The model can now choose an action based on the actual obstruction. label: Computer Use 如何训练
action: 播放多任务练习、反馈与参数更新
actionEn: Play varied practice, feedback and weight updates
look: 训练得到新模型
Training produces an updated model
say: 先看一次练习：点击执行了，却没有创建退货。训练反馈要看任务有没有完成，不能只看有没有点击。 把这样的练习积累起来，训练程序根据反馈反复调整 weights，也就是模型内部学到的参数。OpenAI 的 Computer Use 模型就使用了强化学习，英文是 reinforcement learning。这里把多轮练习和更新缩成一段示意。

Start with one practice attempt: the click ran, but no return was created. Training feedback must reflect the task outcome, rather than a click alone. Across many practice tasks, feedback guides updates to the weights: the model’s learned parameters. OpenAI’s computer-using agent uses reinforcement learning. This diagram condenses many rounds of practice and updates.

label: Jev 是什么
action: 停在术语开场页
actionEn: Hold the chapter opening
look: Jev：面向分类、评分等明确判断
Jev: a model for focused decisions
say: Jev 是 TypeSafe 的 System One 模型，用来处理答案范围清楚的判断。例如：这封邮件该交给哪个部门？我们先看怎样给它出题。
Jev is TypeSafe’s System One model for decisions with a defined answer space. For example, which team should receive an email? Let’s see how to ask it.
transition: 从一封退货邮件开始。
Start with a return email.

label: 认识 Jev
Introducing Jev
end: Jev：面向分类、评分等明确判断
Jev: a model for focused decisions
say: Jev 是 TypeSafe 的 System One 模型，用来处理答案范围清楚的判断。例如：这封邮件该交给哪个部门？我们先看怎样给它出题。
Jev is TypeSafe’s System One model for decisions with a defined answer space. For example, which team should receive an email? Let’s see how to ask it.

label: 谁来定义 Jev 的问题
action: 先问一题，再在同一输入上加一题
actionEn: Ask one question, then add a second over the same input
look: 两题、两个答案；Choice、Score、Noul 是可选题型
Two questions, two answers; Choice, Score and Noul are available types
say: 这封退货邮件就是本次输入，这里叫 state。我们定义问题“交给哪个部门”，再提供退货、账单、物流三个选项。这种题型叫 Choice。Jev 给每个选项一个概率；选项由我们定，判断由模型做。 再加一道题：“客户想退货吗？”Noul 返回“是”的概率。现在两题对应两个答案。下面的 Choice、Score、Noul 是三种题型，Score 用来自定标准打分；它们不是固定三个输出。问题和数量可以随请求改变，不用为每道新题重新训练。

The return email is the input, called state here. We define the question, “Which team?”, and supply returns, billing and shipping as options. This question type is Choice. Jev assigns probabilities; we define the options, and the model makes the judgment. Add “Does the customer want a return?” Noul gives the probability of yes, so two questions now have two answers. Choice, Score and Noul are question types, not three mandatory outputs; Score uses a rating scale we define. Questions and their number can change with each request without retraining for each new question.
transition: 普通 LLM 也能回答；先看它怎样生成文字。
An ordinary LLM can answer too. First, see how it generates text.

label: Decoding：选一个，再预测下一个
labelEn: Decoding: choose a token, then predict the next
action: 停在 We 已进入 context、can 和 will 等待选择的画面
actionEn: Hold We in context with can and will as next candidates
look: We 已加入 context，下一轮候选已出现
We has joined context; the next candidates are visible
say: 普通 LLM 写文字时，会逐步选出下一个 token，这个过程叫 decoding。Token 是词、字符或文字片段。这里已经选出 We，并把它加进左边的 context；右边接着预测 can 还是 will。新生成的内容参与下一步判断，重复这个过程就能写出一句话。

When an ordinary LLM writes text, it selects the next token step by step: decoding. A token can be a word, character or text fragment. We has been added to the context on the left; the next candidates are can and will. Each new token informs the next prediction, and repeating the process produces text.

label: Jev 和 LLM 怎样产生答案
labelEn: How Jev and an LLM produce answers
action: 先看 LLM 逐步生成，再看 Jev 并行输出概率
actionEn: Follow LLM generation, then Jev’s parallel probability outputs
look: 两个独立答案由 API 装进 JSON
The API packages the two independent answers as JSON
say: 回到刚才那封邮件和两道题。左边的 LLM 一次请求就能回答，用 JSON Schema 限定字段和类型。它仍然通过 decoding 顺序生成这份 JSON。画面为了好读，把输出分成了较大的文字片段。 按 TypeSafe 的说明，右边的 Jev 根据同一份 state，并行给出各题的概率，再由 API 包装成 JSON。它省去了把答案逐段写成文字的顺序输出，所以可能降低延迟；具体快多少仍要实测。两边拿到的都是 JSON，产生答案的过程不同。

Return to the same email and two questions. The LLM can answer both in one request, with JSON Schema constraining fields and types. It still decodes the JSON sequentially. We use larger readable chunks for the display. According to TypeSafe, Jev produces each question’s probabilities in parallel from the same state; the API packages them as JSON. Avoiding sequential text output can reduce latency, but the actual gain needs measurement. Both deliver JSON through different output processes.

say: 这次换成重复扣款的邮件，客户还说要留下鞋子。已知应该交给账单部门，示意模型却给“退货”95% 的概率。训练要纠正两件事：判断错了，而且错得很有把握。 和上一章一样，许多练习的反馈用来调整 weights。TypeSafe 把这类继续训练称为 RLCD，目标是判断更准、概率更可信。再看同一封邮件，模型已偏向账单；是否学会，还要换新题检查。

Now the email reports a duplicate charge and says the customer is keeping the shoes. The known answer is billing, but our illustrative model assigns 95% to returns. Training must address both the wrong choice and the misplaced confidence. As in the previous chapter, feedback from many examples adjusts the weights. TypeSafe calls this further training RLCD, aiming for better decisions and better-calibrated probabilities. The same email now favors billing; new cases are still needed to test learning.

label: 用新题检查 Calibration

look: 80% 的含义：长期接近八成正确
80% should mean roughly eight in ten over many cases
say: 上面是没参与训练的新邮件，weights 固定，模型给账单 80% 的概率。Calibration，校准，要看许多类似预测：说八成把握时，长期是否约八成正确。下面的十格只解释这个含义，不能用这一封邮件证明校准。

The new email above was not used in training. With weights fixed, the model gives billing 80%. Calibration checks many such predictions: are those near 80% correct about 80% of the time? The ten squares illustrate that idea; one email cannot establish calibration.

Back to the original return email: Jev makes the decision, code routes the ticket, and an LLM can write a reply. For occasional classification or a complete reply in one call, the existing LLM with JSON may already suffice.

label: RSI 是什么
action: 停在术语开场页
actionEn: Hold the chapter opening
look: RSI、Recursive Self-Improvement 和下一代 AI 的问题独占一页。
RSI, Recursive Self-Improvement and the successor question fill a dedicated page.
say: RSI 是 Recursive Self-Improvement，递归自我改进。关键在于：AI 帮助开发出更会做研发的新 AI，再由新 AI 推动下一轮改进。先从一次最小的改进看起。
RSI means Recursive Self-Improvement: AI helps develop a new AI that is better at research, and that new AI drives another round of improvement. Start with one small improvement loop.
transition: 用排序程序看看，什么改动值得留下。
Use a sorting program to see which changes deserve to stay.

label: 认识 RSI
Introducing RSI
end: RSI、Recursive Self-Improvement 和下一代 AI 的问题独占一页。
RSI, Recursive Self-Improvement and the successor question fill a dedicated page.
say: RSI 是 Recursive Self-Improvement，递归自我改进。关键在于：AI 帮助开发出更会做研发的新 AI，再由新 AI 推动下一轮改进。先从一次最小的改进看起。
RSI means Recursive Self-Improvement: AI helps develop a new AI that is better at research, and that new AI drives another round of improvement. Start with one small improvement loop.

label: 原来的办法 A
labelEn: Start with the original method A
action: 运行 A，停在原来的结果上
actionEn: Run A and hold the starting result
look: A 能做对，先保留 A
A works; keep it for now
say: A 是原来使用的排序程序，它能排对。下面记录比较和写入的次数，把它们相加作为本例的工作量。我们想找一个同样做对、工作量更少的办法。A、B、C 是预写的程序，动画来自它们的实际运行。

A is the original sorting program, and it works. We count comparisons and array writes, adding them to measure work in this example. We want the same correct result with less work. A, B and C are prewritten programs, and the animation follows their execution.

label: 先用原来的 A
Start with A
end: A 能做对，先保留 A
A works; keep it for now
say: A 是原来使用的排序程序，它能排对。下面记录比较和写入的次数，把它们相加作为本例的工作量。我们想找一个同样做对、工作量更少的办法。A、B、C 是预写的程序，动画来自它们的实际运行。

A is the original sorting program, and it works. We count comparisons and array writes, adding them to measure work in this example. We want the same correct result with less work. A, B and C are prewritten programs, and the animation follows their execution.

label: 尝试 B，再尝试 C
action: 依次运行两次尝试；每次检查后自动停住
actionEn: Run the two attempts in order; hold after each check
look: C 通过同一组测试，且操作更少；A 被 C 替换
C passes the same suite with less work and replaces A
say: 第一次尝试 B，只排一遍。操作确实少了，但红色数字的顺序还不对，所以拒绝 B。右边 IN USE 仍然是 A。 B 失败后再试 C。C 通过同样的六项检查，总工作量也更少，才替换 A。这个循环改进了排序程序，还没有改进做研发的 AI，所以本身不等于 RSI。

First, try B with just one pass. It uses less work, but the red numbers are still out of order. Reject B; IN USE on the right remains A. After B fails, try C. It passes the same six checks with less total work, so it replaces A. This loop improved a sorting program, not the AI doing the research. By itself, it is not RSI.
transition: Google 把类似的循环，用到了训练 AI 的程序上。
Google applies a similar loop to code used in AI training.

label: 第一次尝试：B 失败
First attempt: B fails
end: B 顺序不对，继续使用 A
B leaves the output out of order; keep using A
say: 第一次尝试 B，只排一遍。操作确实少了，但红色数字的顺序还不对，所以拒绝 B。右边 IN USE 仍然是 A。
First, try B with just one pass. It uses less work, but the red numbers are still out of order. Reject B; IN USE on the right remains A.

label: 第二次尝试：C 替换 A
Second attempt: C replaces A
end: C 通过同一组测试，且操作更少；A 被 C 替换
C passes the same suite with less work and replaces A
say: B 失败后再试 C。C 通过同样的六项检查，总工作量也更少，才替换 A。这个循环改进了排序程序，还没有改进做研发的 AI，所以本身不等于 RSI。
After B fails, try C. It passes the same six checks with less total work, so it replaces A. This loop improved a sorting program, not the AI doing the research. By itself, it is not RSI.

label: Google 把改进用在了哪里
action: 先停在改好的 kernel，再把它移入训练流程
actionEn: Hold the checked kernel, then move it into training
look: 改好的 K 进入 Gemini 训练；提效数字出现
The improved K enters Gemini training; the reported savings appear
say: 把排序程序换成训练 AI 用的 kernel，也就是反复执行的小段计算程序，比如矩阵乘法。AlphaEvolve 用 Gemini 提出改法，再由评估器检查结果和速度。现在 K 已经通过检查。 同一块 K 已经进入 Gemini 的训练流程。DeepMind 报告，这个 kernel 提速 23%，整体训练时间减少约 1%。它和 RSI 的联系在于：AI 改好的工具，又用来训练 AI。但目前证明的是训练提效，还不是更会研发的新 AI。

Replace the sorting program with a kernel used in AI training: a small repeated computation, such as matrix multiplication. AlphaEvolve uses Gemini to propose changes, then evaluators check correctness and speed. K has now passed those checks. The same K has entered Gemini training. DeepMind reported a 23% kernel speedup and about 1% less total training time. The link to RSI is that a tool improved with AI is used to train AI. This establishes a training-efficiency gain, not a better AI researcher.
transition: 还缺的一步，是让新 AI 接手下一轮改进。
The missing step is for the new AI to take over the next improvement round.

label: 把排序程序换成训练程序
From sorting code to training code

The proposed kernel change passes the checks
say: 把排序程序换成训练 AI 用的 kernel，也就是反复执行的小段计算程序，比如矩阵乘法。AlphaEvolve 用 Gemini 提出改法，再由评估器检查结果和速度。现在 K 已经通过检查。

The same K has entered Gemini training. DeepMind reported a 23% kernel speedup and about 1% less total training time. The link to RSI is that a tool improved with AI is used to train AI. This establishes a training-efficiency gain, not a better AI researcher.

label: 假设训练改进帮助开发 v2
labelEn: Suppose the improvement helps develop v2
action: 显示 v1、训练改进和新 AI v2
actionEn: Show v1, the training improvement and new AI v2
look: v2 出现，但是否更会做研发仍未知
v2 appears; better research ability remains unproven
say: 从这里开始是假设。假如把省下的算力用于更多训练，帮助开发出了右边的 v2，它也不一定比 v1 更会做研发，所以还带着问号。
The rest is hypothetical. Suppose saved compute funds more training and helps develop v2 on the right. That does not establish that v2 is better at research than v1, so it still has a question mark.

label: 从训练节省到新 AI
From training savings to a new AI
end: v2 出现，但是否更会做研发仍未知
v2 appears; better research ability remains unproven
say: 从这里开始是假设。假如把省下的算力用于更多训练，帮助开发出了右边的 v2，它也不一定比 v1 更会做研发，所以还带着问号。
The rest is hypothetical. Suppose saved compute funds more training and helps develop v2 on the right. That does not establish that v2 is better at research than v1, so it still has a question mark.

label: 检验后，让 v2 接手下一轮
labelEn: Test v2, then let it take over
action: 先停在检验条件；再让 v2 沿回路接手 v1 的位置
actionEn: Hold the evaluation conditions; then move v2 into v1’s role
look: v2 接替 v1，提出下一项改进；右侧出现 v3？
v2 replaces v1 and proposes the next improvement; v3? appears on the right
say: 给 v1 和 v2 新的 kernel 优化任务，用相同的尝试预算，比较谁能找到正确、有用的改法。这是在检验下一轮的改进能力，图里还没有胜负。 假设 v2 通过检验，确实更擅长这项工作，它就接过左边 v1 的位置，继续帮助开发 v3。v3 还要重新检验。上一轮得到的新 AI，成为下一轮的改进者，这一步才让改进递归下去。

Give v1 and v2 new kernel-optimization tasks with the same experiment budget. Compare their ability to find correct, useful improvements. This tests their ability to improve the next round; no winner is shown here. If evaluation shows that v2 is better at this work, it takes v1’s place on the left and helps develop v3. v3 must be evaluated again. The AI produced by one round becomes the improver in the next: that is the recursive step.

The closing map
